function.name: MAP_CLONE
function.param: Number of graph inside of library
function.abstract: It creates a copy of a graph

description.p: This function creates a copy on memory of an any graph. The new graph will be in the library 0, and Fenix will assign a new avaliable number for it. The returned value of this function will be the number of the new graph, and it must be saved to can use in any graph operation.
The library 0 or the system library is not limited to 999 graphs, so that it is not possible that this function returns an error if there is not any avaliable number.
If you want to create a new graph inside the FPG library but it is not the system library, then it is recommended to use the function .
